EO 12076 (signed 1978-08-18; 43 FR 37161-37162, Federal Register of August 22, 1978) was read in full in the held govinfo text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12076.txt (PDF pages 15-16; heading Executive Order 12076 of August 18, 1978, subject Levels IV and V of the Executive Schedule; number, date and subject agree with the census register row). Its authority is Section 5317 of Title 5. Section 1-101 places 17 positions, items (a) to (q), in level IV of the Executive Schedule; section 1-102 places 14 positions, items (a) to (n), in level V; section 1-201 provides that nothing in the order terminates or otherwise affects the appointment of the occupant of a listed position who held it immediately before the order's issuance; and section 1-202 revokes Executive Order No. 11861, as amended. The order has no sunset, termination, condition or report clause. The dossier's three own-terms leads (two condition leads and one fixed-term lead) were read in the source-ladder text and come from other documents printed on neighbouring Federal Register pages (the public-inspection notice, the list of rules going into effect and a Governors' proclamation), not from the order. The preamble recites the authority and the purpose (to place two positions in level IV and to codify other positions) and commands nothing beyond the sections. It has no own-terms end, condition, report clause or sunset. The parent order EO 12083 (held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12083.txt, 43 FR 44813, Federal Register of September 29, 1978) was read in full: it establishes the Committee to coordinate Federal energy policy, lists its members in section 1-102, creates an Executive Council, revokes EO 11814, and contains no sunset, termination or report clause. EO 12379 names EO 12083 and not EO 12121 by number; the alternative reading, that an amendment not named by number survives the revocation of the order it amends, leaves a list inside a revoked order with nothing to operate on.
